page.overview:
What is Back Alley?

The is a secondary location in Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator. It is where Scrap Baby, Scraptrap, Molten Freddy, or Lefty reside in. This location is also where the player can throw the salvageable animatronics back by choice.

{|class="article-table" align="center" border="1" cellpadding="1" cellspacing="1" style="text-align:center;"

The Back Alley is a gray-bricked alleyway with multiple garbage bags and trash cans. There are also document papers and posters ("The Legend of the Terrible Man-Wolf", "One Night at the Opera", "Spook Fest", and few unknown advertisement/show posters depicting a grinning clown) printing on walls.

In very rare occasions, there is a possibility that when starting, ending, or dying in a game the player will see a screen of either Scrap Baby, Scraptrap, Molten Freddy, or Lefty in the alley during a thunderstorm.
